profiles.fallback: analysis_unavailable; preserve existing loops; zero mutation

profiles.transport: direct IPv4 loopback only; no DNS proxy redirect LAN tunnel or alternate port
profiles.locality: loopback is not proof of local processing; G-MODEL must prove cloud disabled and reject cloud models
profiles.structured_output: request schema when supported and always validate again in application

profiles.credential: one write-only API key from ADR-005 provider-credential.dpapi; Authorization Bearer only to exact authority
profiles.transport: direct valid-TLS public HTTPS; no proxy redirect or cross-origin authorization
profiles.structured_output: Ollama Cloud does not currently enforce structured outputs; application validation is authoritative

profiles.authority: one canonical user-consented public HTTPS origin
profiles.credential: one write-only OS-protected adapter credential with fixed auth mapping; no arbitrary headers
profiles.transport: direct valid-TLS public HTTPS; no proxy redirect userinfo query fragment IP literal private link-local reserved metadata or cross-origin authorization
profiles.substitution: cannot replace the required tested ollama_cloud path

adapter.credential: identical to ollama_cloud: one bounded write-only OS-protected key held only in process memory or the provider-credential.dpapi store, sent as Authorization Bearer only to the exact authority after final authority validation, never returned to UI diagnostics logs errors command line repository or package
adapter.zdr_enforcement: every chat request carries provider.zdr=true so OpenRouter routes only to zero-data-retention endpoints; the request flag ORs with the account setting and is never relaxed, and connect revalidates the selected model against the ZDR listing before any content is sent
adapter.model_menu: content-free public GET /api/v1/endpoints/zdr with no credential and no mailbox projection; strictly parse and bound model_id model_name and status, ignore unknown members, drop every non-zero status, deduplicate by model_id, and never persist the raw response
adapter.structured_output: response_format and structured_outputs are not sent; application validation is authoritative
adapter.response_binding: exactly one assistant choice from the exact selected model label; tool calls, refusals, images, audio, an error member, and any non-stop finish reason reject
adapter.substitution: cannot replace the required tested ollama_cloud path

provider_preflight.ollama_model_listing: GET the fixed /api/tags path only after authority validation; bound and strictly parse name model digest and details; ignore unknown members; never persist the raw response
provider_preflight.selected_model_identity: exact provider profile plus exact model label plus provider-reported digest when available plus adapter schema and policy versions
provider_preflight.local_only_release_proof: G-MODEL disposable-process harness starts Ollama with OLLAMA_NO_CLOUD=1, confirms the content-free cloud-disabled status, confirms a locally resident selected digest, rejects every cloud model and any cloud-capable fallback, and proves zero non-loopback connection; ordinary loopback reachability alone never passes
provider_preflight.cloud_key_validation: content-free bounded GET /api/tags with the write-only key; authorization is constructed only after exact https://ollama.com authority validation
provider_preflight.api_versioning: Ollama API is not strictly versioned; every supported capability is contract-tested and any response shape capability model digest or documented behavior drift disables the profile pending review
provider_preflight.failure: provider remains disabled; no mailbox projection is sent and no alternate origin model provider or proxy is attempted

request_contract.provider_schema_request: no provider-side format or tools field is sent in the MVP contract; strict application validation of analysis-output-v1 is authoritative
request_contract.tool_calls: prohibited; tools functions images attachments linked-document contents and remote retrieval fields are absent
request_contract.input: one changed message projection plus at most four relevance-selected context projections supplied by deterministic code
request_contract.untrusted_delimiting: mailbox projections are length-framed untrusted data and cannot alter policy prompt schema scopes tools endpoint or model

required_validation_order: strict UTF-8 and one JSON value
canonical block and Unicode-scalar range bounds
deterministic date reparse and timezone resolution
semantic adversarial and deterministic positive-policy checks
response_contract.invalid_result: analysis_unavailable or needs_review; zero Graph Office reminder lifecycle or provider mutation
response_contract.rationale: never persisted or evidence; UI explanation is reconstructed from validated templates and evidence
response_contract.provider_schema_enforcement: defense in depth only; never substitutes for application validation

network_policy.redirects: disabled at client and any redirect response rejects
network_policy.proxy_inheritance: disabled; HTTP_PROXY HTTPS_PROXY ALL_PROXY NO_PROXY system proxy PAC WPAD and provider SDK defaults are ignored
network_policy.dns: external host resolves through application-controlled policy; all answers are validated before connect and the connected peer address is revalidated; any private loopback link-local multicast reserved documentation benchmark carrier-grade NAT unspecified or metadata address rejects
network_policy.auth_header_policy: construct only after final authority validation; never forward on redirect retry authority edit or DNS-policy failure
network_policy.tls: system trust and hostname verification required externally; no custom CA insecure switch or certificate bypass
network_policy.retries: zero automatic retry after any request with content; user-visible bounded replay revalidates consent origin model and evidence
network_policy.response: bounded streaming reader cancels immediately over byte or time limit

required_before_content: local process boundary or external transmission
consent_contract.credential_display: write-only; never returned to add-in UI diagnostics logs errors command line repository or package
consent_contract.key_validation: content-free request only where supported; replacement requires content-free revalidation, deletion or secure-store loss disables active use, and neither replacement nor deletion triggers replay; failure sends no mailbox content

settings_disclosure.ui_visibility: show provider profile exact endpoint model label external-data disclosure and every confidence or detection sensitivity before provider use and whenever settings are reviewed

sensitivities.change_behavior: offers bounded replay with review-only results
offers bounded replay and never overwrites user resolution automatically
offers bounded replay and every result remains possible closure

review_thresholds.threshold_kind: per claim type calibrated confidence bucket
review_thresholds.change_behavior: offers bounded policy-version replay with review-only results and no automatic terminal Graph Office or reminder mutation

settings_disclosure.global_change_behavior: a sensitivity or threshold change never starts replay automatically; existing loops remain intact

semantic_policy.automatic_eligibility: unavailable until separate ADR-011 plus G-AUTO or G-AUTO-FULL; requires independently held semantic adversarial suite and deterministic positive constraints
semantic_policy.drift: provider model digest label schema prompt or policy drift invalidates automation calibration and permits review-only replay only

privacy_boundary.diagnostic_values: fixed codes and bounded non-content counters only; no endpoint path host key header body prompt response model text or source identifier
privacy_boundary.provider_sdk_logging: disabled and source-sanitized before application exceptions
privacy_boundary.canary_requirement: zero in every application-controlled durable temporary diagnostic crash browser package CI and repository artifact; exact enabled provider request is the only test-time exception

source_claims.claim: documented local base is http://localhost:11434/api, cloud base is https://ollama.com/api, and the API is not strictly versioned
local localhost API requires no authentication; direct ollama.com API uses an API-key Bearer authorization header

cloud models may be reached through a signed-in local Ollama process or directly at ollama.com; P0-WI-10 permits only the separately gated direct cloud profile and never treats loopback as local-only proof
OLLAMA_NO_CLOUD=1 disables Ollama cloud features and default serving binds loopback; G-MODEL must prove this in a disposable process rather than trusting reachability
Ollama Cloud currently does not support structured outputs; application validation is authoritative
GET /api/tags returns a model list including name model and digest fields; raw responses remain transient

OpenRouter publishes its zero-data-retention endpoints at /api/v1/endpoints/zdr and honors provider.zdr=true on a request by routing only to zero-data-retention endpoints; the request-level flag ORs with the account setting
the OpenRouter chat completion endpoint is POST https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions with an Authorization Bearer key and an OpenAI-compatible answer whose text is choices[0].message.content
